description: Samples a target of interest for later analysis in your Codex (25 charges).
name: Codex Scanner

patchlogs.name: Heart of Deimos: Update 29
patchlogs.additions: Oxylus Sentinel will scan plants within 20m over 5s. This consumes Codex Scanner charges.

patchlogs.name: Update 26: The Old Blood
patchlogs.changes: Another common issue in user feedback was the unequipping of Gear Items (like the Codex Scanner), or dropping the ‘football’ (usually a pickup for Mobile Defense or Sabotage Missions) when equipping melee or using a melee attack. This has now been changed so that you will no longer drop items or unequip Gear Items when either equipping melee or using a Melee Attack!

patchlogs.name: Plains of Eidolon: Hotfix 22.8.2
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Ember’s Vermillion Helmet flame FX lingering when using a sniper scope, Nosam Cutter, Codex Scanner or Synthesis Scanner.

patchlogs.name: Plains of Eidolon: Hotfix 22.2.5
patchlogs.fixes:
Fixed a crash that would occur when firing the Nosam Cutter and pressing the hotkey for the Nosam Cutter or the Codex Scanner.
Fixed Codex Scanners and Synthesis Scanners appearing very stretch when zooming in a non-standard aspect ratio (ultra wide resolution).

patchlogs.name: Chains of Harrow: Hotfix 21.0.7
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed not being able to use the Codex Scanner to scan Ayatan Statues and other pickups.

patchlogs.name: Update 21: Chains of Harrow
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed the Mars Junction only rewarding 1 Codex Scanner instead of 25.

patchlogs.name: The Glast Gambit: Hotfix 19.10.1+19.10.1.1
patchlogs.changes: If you do not  have a Scanner equipped, scannable plants/objects will display a 'requires Codex Scanner' to give players hints on how to interact with various environment objects.

patchlogs.name: The Vacuum Within: Hotfix #3
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed the Codex Scanner not working on ragdolled enemies.

patchlogs.name: Warframe: Archwing
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed a number of problems with the Codex Scanner (including Helios’s user of the Scanner):Fixed handling of certain compound objects like Death Orbs (you could not scan them and neither could Helios).

patchlogs.name: Hotfix 14.10.3
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed an issue with the Codex Scanner overlay appearing even when no HUD was toggled, content creators rejoice!

patchlogs.name: 13.4.0: Serro + Psa!
patchlogs.fixes: Added in a new Green visual effect that will appear on enemies that have been fully scanned when viewed with the Codex Scanner.

patchlogs.name: Update 11.1.0
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed issue where players knocked into bleedout while using Codex Scanner would lose weapon firing functionality until revived.
